name: rinzu-source
description: Rinzu diagnostics, navigation, completion and formatting through the versioned source protocol.

rinzu.executable.description: Path to the Rinzu executable with the editor command.

rinzu.workspace.description: Package workspace path (relative to the opened folder). Empty uses a manifest in that folder, or single-buffer library checks.

rinzu.entry.description: Explicit .rinzu entry file (relative to the opened folder). Takes precedence over the package workspace and checks its path import graph, including open unsaved files. Reload Window after changing it.
